strategies.label: Keywords‑Only (Embedded Telecom + Gujarat)
strategies.description: Use a keywords‑only search with at most six terms by embedding the telecom vendor context directly into the boolean string. Use the following keyword terms: "Channel Partner Manager" OR "Channel Manager" OR "Partner Manager" AND "telecom equipment" AND B2B AND Gujarat. This uses the role cluster (3 terms) and adds three filtering terms (telecom equipment, B2B, Gujarat). No location filter, no industry filter. This strategy captures candidates who explicitly mention Gujarat and telecom equipment in their profile text.
